title: English Listening Practice for Beginners: My Weekend! (A1-A2)

header.titleZh: 初學者英語聽力練習：我的週末！ (A1-A2)
header.titleEn: English Listening Practice for Beginners: My Weekend! (A1-A2)

sentences.en: What did you do last weekend? Was it exciting, boring, interesting?
sentences.tc: 上週末你做了什麼？是令人興奮、無聊還是有趣？

sentences.en: I am going to tell you about my weekend.
sentences.tc: 我要告訴你我的週末。

sentences.en: He edits these videos. I decided to visit my parents last minute around 4:00 p.m. But at 4:00 p.m. The traffic in Mexico City is crazy.
sentences.tc: 他編輯這些影片。我決定在最後一刻下午 4:00 左右去看我的父母。但下午 4:00墨西哥城的交通很瘋狂。

sentences.en: I decided to wait for the traffic to settle down. Traffic never settles down in Mexico City, but around 8 p.m. It's not too crazy anymore. But there was still so much.
sentences.tc: 我決定等待交通穩定下來。墨西哥城的交通永遠不會平靜下來，但晚上 8 點左右就會出現交通擁堵。已經不太瘋狂了。但還是有那麼多。

sentences.en: Traffic. I was sat in traffic for about 2 hours.
sentences.tc: 交通。我在路上堵了大約2個小時。

sentences.en: Finally started driving.
sentences.tc: 終於開始開車了。

sentences.en: He drove all the way to my hometown where my dad picked me up in his car.
sentences.tc: 他一路開到我的家鄉，我爸爸開車來接我。

sentences.en: He drove his car to the bus station.
sentences.tc: 他開著車前往汽車站。

sentences.en: I sat in the front seat of the car, not the back seat, the front seat. Because my mom wasn't there.
sentences.tc: 我坐在車的前座，不是後座，是前座。因為我媽媽不在。

sentences.en: I got to sit in the front seat. I was a little hungry.
sentences.tc: 我必須坐在前排座位上。我有點餓了。

sentences.en: I hadn't had any dinner yet. So, my dad drove me to get some esquites. Have corn, mayonnaise, lime, tajin. It's a mixture of good stuff. It's the perfect late night snack.
sentences.tc: 我還沒吃晚餐。於是，我爸爸開車帶我去見識一些紳士。有玉米、蛋黃醬、酸橙、tajin。這是好東西的混合物。這是完美的深夜小吃。

sentences.en: We bought two esquites, one for me and one for my mom,.
sentences.tc: 我們買了兩件 esquites，一件給我，一件給我媽。

sentences.en: We drove home.
sentences.tc: 我們開車回家。

sentences.en: We ate our esquites.
sentences.tc: 我們吃了我們的紳士。

sentences.en: They sell breakfast, coffee. You can sit down and chat with friends or family while.
sentences.tc: 他們賣早餐、咖啡。你可以坐下來與朋友或家人聊天。

sentences.en: You eat breakfast. I ordered a maple donut with bacon. That was the perfect combination. Maple with bacon. So good. The doughnut was fluffy and soft but crunchy on the outside.
sentences.tc: 你吃早餐。我點了一個楓糖甜甜圈和培根。那是完美的組合。楓葉配培根。超好的。甜甜圈蓬鬆柔軟，但外面脆脆的。

sentences.en: I also ordered a omelette with spinach and I ordered a cappuccino. My dad drove us all back home.
sentences.tc: 我還點了菠菜煎蛋捲，還點了一杯卡布奇諾。我爸爸開車送我們大家回家。

sentences.en: We watched a movie called Roommates on Netflix.
sentences.tc: 我們在 Netflix 上觀看了一部名為《室友》的電影。

sentences.en: It was just frustrating and just annoying to see how her roommate got away with everything again and again.
sentences.tc: 看到她的室友一次又一次地逃脫懲罰，真是令人沮喪又煩人。

sentences.en: It was really good. Later, my dad drove me to my nail appointment. As you can see,.

sentences.tc: 我又做了指甲。我以前從來不做指甲，但最近有了我的影片和戒指，我真的很喜歡低頭看。
